test_description: Verify 'Last Write Wins' conflict resolution when modifying reading session offline
business_risk: Critical - Data corruption or loss leads to user churn
preconditions: User logged in; Book 'Dune' exists in library; Initial progress page 50
test_steps: 1. Go offline on Mobile; 2. Update 'Dune' progress to page 60 (Time T1); 3. Simulate Backend update to page 55 (Time T2 > T1); 4. Go online on Mobile; 5. Trigger Sync
expected_result: Backend record remains at page 55 (Server T2 > Client T1) OR Client updates to 55; Conflict logged
test_data_needs: User account with pre-seeded library data
tools_required: Flutter Integration Test; WireMock (for backend simulation)
dependencies: Isar Local DB; Backend Sync API
success_criteria: Data consistency achieved across client and server based on timestamp logic

test_description: Validate Webhook processing for Subscription Renewal
business_risk: Critical - Revenue loss if access is revoked incorrectly
test_steps: 1. Send mocked Apple/Google 'DID_RENEW' webhook payload to backend endpoint; 2. Verify response 200 OK; 3. Query Database for User Subscription Expiry
expected_result: User subscription expiry date extended; Audit log entry created; User maintains Premium access
test_data_needs: Mocked JWT/JWS Webhook Payload; Test User ID
success_criteria: Database reflects new expiry date accurately

test_description: Verify resilience and latency when OpenAI API is throttled
business_risk: High - Poor UX and timeouts during premium feature usage
preconditions: Premium User logged in; Recommendation service running
test_steps: 1. Simulate OpenAI API latency > 5s or 429 Rate Limit; 2. Request AI Recommendation via Mobile App
expected_result: Client shows 'Generating...' then graceful 'Try again later' or Cached Fallback; Backend logs warning; Circuit Breaker opens
success_criteria: App does not crash; User receives feedback within 3s; System recovers

test_description: Enforce 20-book library limit for Free Users
business_risk: Medium - Revenue leakage if limits bypassed
preconditions: Free User with exactly 20 books in library
test_steps: 1. Navigate to Search; 2. Select new book; 3. Tap 'Add to Library'
expected_result: Add action blocked; 'Upgrade to Premium' modal displayed; Backend rejects request if forced
test_data_needs: Free User account seeded with 20 items
